provenance_note: Expected annual rain, inflow, demand, yield, overflow volume and days, empty days, coverage, efficiency, savings, the DIN 1989-1 simplified tank and the GSV Hemelwater 2023 minimum tank, infiltration and buffer volumes were computed by bench-src/ref/gen_plbrainwater.py, an independent Python implementation written from the published method (_plb/rain/METHOD.md: Markov-chain synthetic daily rain from the KMI Uccle 1991-2020 normals with the Park-Miller minstd generator, yield-after-spillage daily balance of EN 16941-1, DIN 1989-1 6 % rule, GSV Hemelwater 2023 articles as quoted in METHOD.md §4), not from the page code. Honest scope (D-PLB-10): consistency with METHOD + 10 external anchors whose expected values were written down by hand from the decree text (BVR 10.02.2023 art. 7 §1, §2, §3, §6, art. 8, art. 9), from the DIN 1989-1 simplified formula and from the sum of the KMI monthly normals (r4 Y6-5: one-year series, every month meets its normal); the generator stops if the method disagrees with an anchor, and the bench checks the page against the anchor numbers separately. Six r3 input cases (X3-1): the reference applies the input rule of METHOD §7 itself (an unrecognised choice -> valid:false, error choice:<field>) and the page must refuse them with the same code and show no result. The KMI normals and the DIN 1989-1 Table 3 yield coefficients are input data of the method.
